WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        CASE WHEN rtrim(lower(o.status)) = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_returned
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
        ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
        ON p.product_id = i.product_id
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(is_returned) AS returned_lines,
    CAST(SUM(is_returned) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_id, product_name

explanation: This procedure builds a per-product return report. For every order line, it joins to the order and product, counts all lines for each product, and counts how many of those lines have an order status of "returned". It then stores the product ID, name, total lines, returned lines, and the return rate (returned lines divided by total lines) as a float.
